method.max_spawn_bytes: largest spawn-prompt template naming the agent, as written, placeholders unfilled, UTF-8 bytes; null when none was found
method.resident_tokens: Math.round(resident_bytes / 4) (CHARS_PER_TOKEN from lib/context-audit.cjs; UTF-8 bytes >= chars, so slightly high for non-ASCII)
method.source: git ls-tree and git show only; no checkout, no worktree, no model call, no network
